topics.name: Normal Edges
notes: - Edge 定义节点之间的执行顺序。
- START 是入口，END 表示结束。
- 一个节点可以连到多个后续节点，它们会在同一步并行执行。

topics.name: Conditional Edges
topics.description: Choosing the next node at runtime.
notes: - 用路由函数根据当前 state 决定下一个节点。
- 路由函数返回下一个节点的名称（或 END）。
- 也可以传入映射字典，把返回值映射到节点名。
- 节点也可以返回 Command，在一个返回值里同时更新 state 并指定下一个节点。

questions.title: Which special nodes mark the entry and the exit of a LangGraph graph?
questions.explanation: START and END are imported from langgraph.graph. START connects to the first node and END terminates the run.

questions.title: What happens after node a finishes?
questions.codeSnippet:
builder.add_edge(START, "a")
builder.add_edge("a", "b")
builder.add_edge("a", "c")
builder.add_edge("b", "d")
builder.add_edge("c", "d")
builder.add_edge("d", END)

options.text: b and c run in parallel in the next step, then d runs
Only b runs and c is skipped
The graph raises an error because a has two outgoing edges
b runs, and c runs only after b has finished

questions.explanation: Several outgoing edges fan out to parallel nodes in the same step. Because both b and c point to d, d runs after both are done. Parallel updates to one key need a reducer.

questions.title: compile() fails with an error about an unknown node. Why?
questions.codeSnippet:
builder.add_node("agent", agent_node)
builder.add_edge(START, "agent")
builder.add_edge("agent", "tools")
graph = builder.compile()

options.text: An edge points to 'tools' but no node named 'tools' was added
START cannot be connected to a node

questions.explanation: Every node used in an edge must be registered with add_node first.

questions.title: What does a routing function passed to add_conditional_edges return?

options.text: The name of the next node, or END

questions.explanation: The router inspects the state and returns a node name. You can also pass a mapping to translate return values to node names.

questions.title: Fill in the method that registers the routing function.
questions.codeSnippet:
def route(state: State) -> str:
    last = state["messages"][-1]
    return "tools" if last.tool_calls else END

builder.______("agent", route)
questions.explanation: add_conditional_edges(source, router) calls the router after the source node and follows the node it returns.

questions.title: Which return value lets a node both update the state and choose the next node?

options.text: A Command with update and goto

questions.explanation: Command(update=..., goto=...) combines a state update and routing in one return value. A plain dict only updates state.
